description:
Eleven real parasites, from the jewel wasp that walks a cockroach home like a dog to the brain-eating amoeba that kills 97% of the people it reaches, and Doug plays host to every one. First in costume as a roach, an ant, a cricket, a snail and a rat, then as himself.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
